title: PHASE: Multi-Regime Modeling of Incompressible Magnetohydrodynamics
abstract: arXiv:2609.37609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) is central to plasma modeling in astrophysics, space science, fusion, and engineering, but resolving multiscale MHD dynamics is computationally expensive. Machine-learning surrogates enable fast inference by learning reusable solution operators, yet existing models require separate training for each physical regime, limiting generalization across varying parameter settings. We introduce PHASE, a PHysics-Adaptive Scalable operator with residual Error correction, designed to model incompressible MHD across varying physical parameters with a single model. PHASE combines transfer learning, regime-aware adaptation, physics-centered learning, and residual refinement to improve both physical fidelity and generalization across MHD regimes. Together, these improvements achieve state-of-the-art prediction accuracy on two-dimensional MHD turbulence by reducing relative $L_2$ errors on physical fields by more than an order

translated_title: PHASE：不可压缩磁流体动力学的多状态建模
translated_abstract: 磁流体动力学（MHD）是天体物理学、空间科学、聚变和工程领域中等离子体建模的核心，但对多尺度MHD动力学的求解计算成本高昂。机器学习代理模型通过学习可复用的解算子实现快速推理，然而现有模型需要对每个物理状态单独训练，限制了其在不同参数设置之间的泛化能力。我们提出了PHASE——一种具有残差误差校正的物理自适应可扩展算子，旨在用单一模型对跨不同物理参数的不可压缩MHD进行建模。PHASE融合了迁移学习、状态感知自适应、以物理为中心的学习以及残差精炼，从而提升跨MHD状态的物理保真度与泛化能力。这些改进共同实现了在二维MHD湍流上最先进的预测精度，将物理场的相对$L_2$误差降低了一个数量级以上。
tldr: PHASE提出了一种物理自适应可扩展算子，通过结合迁移学习、状态感知自适应、物理中心学习和残差误差校正，用单一模型实现对不同物理参数下不可压缩磁流体动力学的建模，将二维MHD湍流的相对L2误差降低一个数量级以上，达到最先进的预测精度。
en_tdlr: PHASE is a physics-adaptive scalable operator with residual error correction that models incompressible MHD across varying physical parameters with a single model, combining transfer learning, regime-aware adaptation, physics-centered learning, and residual refinement to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy on 2D MHD turbulence by reducing relative L2 errors by more than an order of magnitude.
